policy: RuntimeBinding is bounded typed evidence and never an executor or durable runtime store
runtime kinds are NO_RUNTIME, CHECKOUT_ONLY, DOCKER, DOCKER_COMPOSE, SYSTEMD, PROCESS_MANAGER and PASSENGER
cardinality is explicit as NO_RUNTIME, SINGLE_RUNTIME, MULTI_RUNTIME or UNKNOWN
server observation remains runtime truth and Live State remains the reconciled projection
registry declarations are cross-check evidence only and never override current observed runtime truth
missing runtime observation remains UNVERIFIED and never becomes NO_RUNTIME
stale or unavailable runtime evidence fails closed
component/server bindings are validated before resolution
resolver performs no restart, rebuild, SSH mutation, authorization inference or persistence
results contain bounded evidence only and never raw shell output

behavior: GW-08 resolves typed runtime bindings from current server resolution plus bounded observed runtime evidence
Docker, Docker Compose, systemd, process-manager, Passenger, checkout-only and explicit no-runtime states are representable
multi-runtime targets are represented without assuming one runtime per project
declarations cannot override observed runtime truth
GW-08 wrapper binds canonical contract metadata and remains READ_ONLY
